Gorgias

On Non-Being or On Nature 

 

 

 

 

Gorgias of Leontini 
lived about 483-375 B.C. The following are a set of theses he defends in his work 
On Non-Being or On Nature.  

Chronologies 

Western Civilization: Greek Philosophy

Mediterranean: Hellenic Greek Culture

1. Nothing exists.

2. Even if something did exist, it would be incomprehensible to human beings.

3. Even if someone could comprehend what exists, it could not be explained or communicated to anyone else.

From: Drew A. Hyland, 
The Origins of Philosophy: From Myth to Meaning
, (New York: G. P. Putnam's Sons, 1973) p.324.
